name: Lesteena Dai Rakios
original_name: レスティーナ・ダイ・ラキオス
source:
The Crown Princess of the Kingdom of Rakios, Lesteena's severe demeanor hides a kindhearted soul who abhors her father the king's greedy, heavy-handed ways and longs desperately for peace to come to Phantasmagoria. When she drops her guard, one can see the weight of her responsibility bearing down upon her shoulders.
